summary: CIBC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 23, 2026 underwriting agreement and counsels' validity opinions for a US$1.3bn senior notes offering: US$300m floating-rate notes due 2030 and US$1.0bn 5.627% fixed-to-floating notes due 2030, issued under the bank's F-3 shelf and 2010 base indenture as supplemented. Joint bookrunners include CIBC World Markets, BNP Paribas, BofA, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown by the registrant, not a special situation; no equity stake, premium, board recommendation or change-of-control mechanic is present. Watch only funding-cost and spread implications.
